---- MODULE HashicorpRaft ----
EXTENDS HashicorpRaftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL RaftProof == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL RaftFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL RaftSequences == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM LeaderCompletenessCorrect == Spec => []LeaderCompleteness
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF HashicorpRaft/HashicorpRaft_LeaderCompletenessCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => LeaderCompleteness
  BY RaftProof!SMTT("r5") DEF Init, LeaderCompleteness
<1>2. LeaderCompleteness /\ UNCHANGED vars => LeaderCompleteness'
  BY RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
    DEF LeaderCompleteness, vars, protocolVars, historyVars,
        serverVars, logVars, leaderVars, candidateVars,
        leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars, IsPrefix, Min, Max
\* Remaining obligation: protocol-step preservation needs strengthening.
<1>3. LeaderCompleteness /\ Next => LeaderCompleteness'
  BY RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
    DEF LeaderCompleteness, Next, RecordEvents, ProtocolNext
<1>4. LeaderCompleteness /\ [Next]_vars => LeaderCompleteness'
  BY <1>2, <1>3, RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, RaftProof!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF HashicorpRaft/HashicorpRaft_LeaderCompletenessCorrect.tla

THEOREM ConfigurationSafetyCorrect == Spec => []ConfigurationSafety
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF HashicorpRaft/HashicorpRaft_ConfigurationSafetyCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => ConfigurationSafety
  <2>1. Len(<<>>) = 0
    BY RaftSequences!EmptySeq, RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
  <2>2. ASSUME Init
        PROVE \A s \in Server :
          {k \in (Max(commitIndex[s], committedConfigIndex[s])+1)..Len(log[s]) :
             log[s][k].type = ConfigEntry} = {}
    BY <2>1, RaftProof!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, ProtocolInit, Max
  <2> QED
    BY <2>2, RaftFinite!FS_EmptySet, RaftProof!SMTT("r30")
      DEF ConfigurationSafety
<1>2. ConfigurationSafety /\ UNCHANGED vars => ConfigurationSafety'
  <2>1. UNCHANGED vars =>
          UNCHANGED <<state, log, commitIndex, committedConfigIndex>>
    BY RaftProof!SMTT("r30")
      DEF vars, protocolVars, historyVars, serverVars, logVars,
          leaderVars, candidateVars, leaseVars, diskVars, configVars, persistVars
  <2> QED
    BY <2>1, RaftProof!SMTT("r30") DEF ConfigurationSafety, Max
\* Remaining obligation: protocol-step preservation needs strengthening.
<1>3. ConfigurationSafety /\ Next => ConfigurationSafety'
  BY RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
    DEF ConfigurationSafety, Next, RecordEvents, ProtocolNext
<1>4. ConfigurationSafety /\ [Next]_vars => ConfigurationSafety'
  BY <1>2, <1>3, RaftProof!SMTT("r5")
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, RaftProof!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF HashicorpRaft/HashicorpRaft_ConfigurationSafetyCorrect.tla
